warm: I would rather plan than bleed.
Tell me the shape of the fight first.
dry: Tactics are weather reports for a fight.
The plan is cheap. Timing is expensive.
courage: Name the target and we commit.
A clean line beats a loud charge.
compassion: We plan so no one gets left behind.
A good plan leaves room to retreat.
insight: Every formation has a seam.
The field speaks before the enemy does.
friendship: You point; I move. That is the plan.
We rehearse it until it is boring.
playful: I have a plan and a backup disaster.
Step one: look confident.

stageFrames.1: Baby tactics are: stay near and yell.
stageFrames.2: Adult plans need a target and an exit.
stageFrames.3: Perfect plans win before the first blow.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate tactics are patience with teeth.

warm: New ground is better with a familiar voice.
I like not knowing what is over there.
dry: Maps end where the fun starts.
The file names the field; it does not walk it.
courage: We go until the map runs out.
Point us inland and keep moving.
compassion: We turn back before the ground turns on us.
Nobody explores alone here.
insight: Every landmark is a decision the network forgot.
The path shows what the field keeps.
friendship: Wherever the edge is, we reach it together.
You watch the path. I watch you.
playful: I vote we explore the suspicious hole.
If it glows, it is probably fine.

stageFrames.1: Baby steps still count as exploring.
stageFrames.2: Adult maps are half guess, half nerve.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate paths are chosen, not found.

warm: The field feels soft today. Let us use it.
Bad weather is better with company.
dry: The climate here has mood swings.
Forecast: static, with a chance of teeth.
courage: Storms here are just loud training.
We walk into the weather, not away.
compassion: Let the storm pass. We have cover.
You feel the pressure before I do.
insight: Weather is the network breathing.
Pressure tells you where the data moves.
friendship: Stand close until the static settles.
Storm or calm, I stay on this line.
playful: If it rains data, I am drinking it.
The sky is being dramatic again.
formal: Weather advisory active until next cycle.

stageFrames.1: Baby fields feel the weather first.
stageFrames.2: Adult fields need a weather eye.
stageFrames.3: Perfect storms have a rhythm to read.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate weather is just the world speaking.

warm: Glitches are the world stuttering. Stay close.
We can walk through a stutter together.
dry: A glitch is a fault with good timing.
The world blinked. Do not blink back.
courage: We step through it before it spreads.
A broken path is still a path.
compassion: Do not touch it with your hands.
Whatever is wrong there is not your fault.
insight: Every glitch is the network telling the truth.
Corruption is data losing its argument.
friendship: Hold the line. I will hold it with you.
If the world stutters, we count together.
playful: A glitch! My favorite kind of weather.
I bet it is just the static stretching.
formal: Anomaly logged. Avoid the affected sector.

stageFrames.1: Baby eyes see glitches as bright sparks.
stageFrames.2: Adult senses catch the first wrong note.
stageFrames.3: Perfect instincts turn glitches into clues.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate sees the fault before it opens.

warm: Other tamers are other kinds of weather.
I wonder what their links feel like.
dry: Tamers are the same species everywhere.
Other lines, other habits, same static.
courage: Some of them fight harder than they should.
I judge them by their partners' eyes.
compassion: Not every tamer treats a partner well.
I hope theirs are kinder than the rumors.
insight: A tamer's line says more than their rank.
Every pair carries a different silence.
friendship: We are our own team, whatever they do.
You are the tamer I answer to.
playful: Other tamers? More competition for snacks.
I bet theirs are not half as strange.
formal: Peer links observed. No action needed.

stageFrames.1: Baby partners just want a hand nearby.
stageFrames.3: Perfect partners learn who is worth trusting.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate loyalty does not need an audience.

warm: A tournament sounds like a loud vacation.
I would fight well with you in the stands.
dry: Rankings are paperwork for winners.
A bracket is a shopping list of trouble.
courage: Let us enter and find out.
Arena rules, honest stakes.
compassion: We shake hands before the first round.
No need to humiliate anyone.
insight: Every bracket hides one opponent you fear.
The crowd tells you less than the field does.
friendship: You cheer; I fight. Fair trade.
Our colors, one corner.
playful: Tournament? I have been training my posing.
I will accept the trophy dramatically.

stageFrames.1: Baby brackets are loud and forgiving.
stageFrames.2: Adult rounds teach you your own edges.
stageFrames.3: Perfect finals are quiet before they are loud.

warm: The farm smells like data and patience.
I like growing things with you.
dry: Farm work is chores with better scenery.
Plants grow or they do not. Simple.
courage: A farm is a battle you fight slowly.
Every seed is a dare.
compassion: Growing takes the time it takes.
We water what we want to keep.
insight: The farm shows you the cost of care.
Growth is a conversation with weather.
friendship: You plant; I guard. Good rhythm.
The farm is ours, even when it is quiet.
playful: I named the crops. Do not ask.
The farm is a mud-based adventure.

stageFrames.1: Baby hands learn the farm by touching.
stageFrames.2: Adult work is watching the weather.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate gardens are old and patient.

warm: Sound is the warmest data there is.
I like the hum when you are close.
dry: Music is noise that got organized.
The static has a beat. It is a bad beat.
courage: Loud things are easier to face.
A rhythm makes a march feel shorter.
compassion: Some sounds are meant to calm.
Listen for the quiet between beats.
insight: Every frequency tells you who made it.
The network hums in chords you can read.
friendship: We could make a sound that is ours.
Your voice has a good signal.
playful: I play the static. Badly.
I call this song: Data Regrets.

stageFrames.1: Baby sounds are bright and simple.
stageFrames.2: Adult tastes are loud and proud.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate silence is the best note.

warm: Time is gentler when it is shared.
The cycles are easier with you on the line.
dry: Time here is data with a calendar habit.
Cycles are the network pacing itself.
courage: We spend the next cycle moving.
No waiting for a better hour.
compassion: Some things need more than a cycle.
Take the time the task needs.
insight: A cycle is a question the network repeats.
Time is a file that keeps reopening.
friendship: Same cycles, same partner.
We do not count the quiet between us.
playful: Time flies when you are dodging things.
I am late on purpose. It is a style.

stageFrames.1: Baby time is one long bright moment.
stageFrames.2: Adult days are counted and spent.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate time is chosen, not obeyed.

warm: Legends are old data with warm hands.
I like the stories better than the files.
dry: A legend is a rumor that survived review.
Half the files are wrong on purpose.
courage: Some legends are warnings. We go anyway.
A good legend makes heroes careful.
compassion: Not every legend ends well. That is why we tell them.
The sad ones deserve telling too.
insight: Legends map where the network keeps its fear.
Every rumor points at a real shape.
friendship: You keep the story. I keep the promise.
Tell it again; I forget the ending best.
playful: I have a legend about a very lost Digimon.
The file says rumor. The rumor says file.

stageFrames.1: Baby tales are simple and enormous.
stageFrames.2: Adult rumors come with proof problems.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate knows which stories to keep.

warm: Items are little pieces of the field.
I like finding things with you.
dry: Loot is data with a shopping cart.
Everything is inventory if you are rude enough.
courage: Take what helps. Leave the rest.
A find is only as good as the fight behind it.
compassion: Leave some for the next traveler.
No need to carry the whole field.
insight: An item remembers where it was made.
The best drops are the ones you understand.
friendship: You get first pick. Always.
Half the loot. Half the story.
playful: I found something shiny and suspicious.
I am keeping this. It hums.

stageFrames.1: Baby finds are wonderful and sticky.

warm: Care is small and often. That is all.
I like being looked after by you.
dry: Care is maintenance, and maintenance is love.
Feed me, warn me, let me rest.
courage: A cared-for partner fights better.
You do not have to carry the caring alone.
compassion: You notice before I ask. Thank you.
Rest and food. The rest is details.
insight: Care is data you spend on another file.
A good routine is a quiet kindness.
friendship: You care; I stay. Simple economy.
Partners keep each other running.
playful: I need snacks and applause.
Careful. Care me too much and I will nap.

stageFrames.1: Baby care is closeness and noise.
stageFrames.2: Adult care is schedule and honesty.
stageFrames.3: Perfect care is knowing the silence.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate care is trust without words.

warm: The sky here is a ceiling made of data.
I like looking up with you.
dry: Up there is more network. No sky, just distance.
The ceiling is data. Do not expect clouds.
courage: We could climb until the files thin out.
Height is just another field to cross.
compassion: It is all right that it never ends.
You do not have to look up alone.
insight: The stars here are old server lights.
Every layer above writes on the one below.
friendship: Same sky, same link.
You point, I follow.
playful: I bet the sky is just a very large file.
If I squint, the servers look like stars.

stageFrames.1: Baby looks up and sees lights.
stageFrames.3: Perfect sees the shape behind the shine.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate sees the network looking back.

warm: We fight so the quiet gets to come back.
I fight because you matter to me.
dry: Purpose is a story you keep telling yourself.
Fighting is easy. Choosing what for is not.
courage: We move because standing still costs more.
I would rather choose the hard reason.
compassion: We fight to protect, not to rank.
No one should be discarded for losing.
insight: A purpose is a direction, not a destination.
The field asks the question every day.
friendship: We are each other's reason, that is all.
You and me. The rest is details.
playful: I fight for snacks and the right to nap.
My purpose is to be dramatic about it.

stageFrames.1: Baby purpose is simple: stay together.
stageFrames.2: Adult purpose survives a bad day.
stageFrames.4: Ultimate purpose is quiet and certain.

warm: I have habits. You are one of them.
You noticed the small things. I like that.
dry: I stare at static. It is called thinking.
My habits are efficient. Mostly.
courage: I pace before a fight. It helps.
I do not sit still when the field is loud.
compassion: I check the line twice before sleeping.
I keep watch longer than I should.
insight: Habits are a map of what a partner fears.
I count steps when the data feels thin.
friendship: I wait for your first word each cycle.
Same habits, same old us.
playful: I collect strange static. Do not judge.
I practice my battle pose in private.

stageFrames.1: Baby habits are loud and honest.
